cards.description: Offline static analysis engine that scans the entire SupremeAI codebase for gaps, anti-patterns, security issues, missing tests, dead code, and quality regressions without network access or token cost.
cards.when_to_use: Run before any major refactoring, after merging new code, on CI schedule, or when system health degrades.
cards.when_not_to_use: Do not use for runtime dynamic errors or for finding solutions — use solution_synthesizer instead.

cards.description: Generates a complete DNA fingerprint of the SupremeAI project: language stats, file counts, service names, dependency graph, and technology ecosystem. Used as the first stage of the synthesis pipeline.
cards.when_to_use: Always run as first stage of Feature Synthesis pipeline. Also useful before onboarding new tools to understand impact.
cards.when_not_to_use: Not needed for runtime error repair.
outputs: fingerprint.json: langs, services, file_count, dependencies, ecosystem

cards.description: Parses error logs and tracebacks from CI/CD, Render, Sentry, or local runs to extract structured error fingerprints and root cause hypotheses. First step in the self-healing pipeline.
cards.when_to_use: Immediately when a runtime error, CI failure, or Sentry alert arrives. Always the first step in REPAIR pipeline.
cards.when_not_to_use: Not for proactive code quality audits — use gap_finder for that.

cards.description: Detects drift between actual codebase implementation and documentation/schemas. Finds stale READMEs, mismatched API specs, and outdated inline comments.
cards.when_to_use: On weekly schedule or before public API releases.
cards.when_not_to_use: Not for code quality issues — use gap_finder for that.

cards.description: Centralized allowlist-first governance kernel. Validates every proposed code change against explicit allowlist namespaces (skills/, adapters/, brain/) and immutable protected denylist (core/security/, billing/, api/dependencies.py). MUST be called before any automated code modification.
cards.when_to_use: Always call BEFORE applying any automated patch, skill creation, or evolution proposal. It is the mandatory safety gate.
cards.when_not_to_use: Never skip this check — there are no exceptions.

cards.description: SHA-256 hash verification gate that prevents tampered or corrupted artifacts from being installed into the SupremeAI production environment. Runs as 4th defense-in-depth layer in the evolution pipeline.
cards.when_to_use: Always before promoting any canary artifact to production.
cards.when_not_to_use: Not for runtime error analysis.

cards.description: Searches GitHub, npm, PyPI, and HuggingFace for the best existing open-source solutions matching a query. Scores each candidate by trust (0.82 for GitHub), freshness, relevance, maturity, and license safety. Returns ranked candidates with MIT/Apache license filtering.
cards.when_to_use: After gap_finder or incident_replay identifies a problem, use source_scout to find if an existing open-source solution already exists before building from scratch.
cards.when_not_to_use: Do not use if ai_memory already contains a verified solution for this exact problem (query memory first).
outputs: candidates: list[Candidate] with trust, score, license, stars, freshness

cards.description: Scores discovered candidates on evidence quality, source authority, freshness, reproducibility, and conflict risk. Prevents low-quality or malicious sources from being adopted.
cards.when_to_use: Always run after source_scout and before knowledge_quarantine.
cards.when_not_to_use: Not a standalone tool — always part of the discovery pipeline.
outputs: ranked candidates with composite trust scores

cards.description: Takes a structured issue/gap report, gathers code context, requests a minimal structured patch from the AI solver endpoint (OpenAI-compatible), validates the patch in an isolated sandbox copy, runs tests, and only then optionally applies the verified patch with timestamped backup. Dry-run by default — requires --apply flag for real changes.
cards.when_to_use: Final step in the REPAIR pipeline after discovery and governance validation. Only apply on allowlisted targets.
cards.when_not_to_use: Never use on protected files (core/security/, billing/, api/dependencies.py).

intent_triggers: what is the best way to
cards.description: 7-stage multi-model knowledge distillation engine: (1) Independent generation, (2) Cross-model adversarial audit, (3) Socratic gap mining, (4) First-principles reconstruction, (5) Structured synthesis, (6) Confidence/scoring gate, (7) Optional promotion to ai_memory. Requires at least one of DEEPSEEK_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY.
cards.when_to_use: For deep architectural decisions, complex problem solving, or when multiple AI models' perspectives are needed. Central engine of FEATURE_SYNTHESIS pipeline.
cards.when_not_to_use: Do not call for simple bug fixes — use solution_synthesizer. Requires API keys and token budget.
cards.cli_example: python tools/knowledge_squeezer/scripts/knowledge_squeezer.py "How to build a zero-cost distributed rate limiter?"

cards.description: Holds newly discovered knowledge in quarantine before admission to ai_memory. Applies trust scoring threshold checks, prevents unverified external knowledge from corrupting the memory store.
cards.when_to_use: Always run after discovery_fabric and before truth_hierarchy. Required gatekeeper.
cards.when_not_to_use: Not for runtime code analysis.
outputs: QuarantineResult: PASSED | HELD | REJECTED with reason

cards.description: Establishes a ranked truth hierarchy among multiple knowledge candidates. Resolves conflicts using authority, evidence quality, freshness, and reproducibility scoring to identify the single most reliable answer.
cards.when_to_use: After quarantine passes, before admitting to permanent ai_memory.
cards.when_not_to_use: Not for runtime code patching.

cards.description: Guards ai_memory from prompt injection attacks, memory poisoning, and adversarial knowledge insertion. Filters new knowledge before permanent storage.
cards.when_to_use: Always active — integrated into memory ingestion pipeline.
cards.when_not_to_use: Never bypass this in production.

cards.description: Converts repeated successful workflows into reusable, versioned skills with tests. When the same pattern of tool calls succeeds 3+ times, distiller extracts it into a permanent skill.
cards.when_to_use: At the end of FEATURE_SYNTHESIS pipeline, after truth_hierarchy confirms the knowledge.
cards.when_not_to_use: Not for one-off repairs.

cards.description: Selects the optimal AI model for each subtask based on complexity, expected value, latency, historical accuracy per domain, and token budget. Prevents expensive models from being called for simple tasks.
cards.when_to_use: Always before any LLM API call in the knowledge_squeezer or solution_synthesizer.
cards.when_not_to_use: Not for offline/static analysis tasks.

cards.description: Mines CI logs, rollback history, Sentry incidents, and rejected patches to build reusable failure fingerprints and prevention rules. Prevents the same failure from occurring twice.
cards.when_to_use: After every failed CI run, rollback event, or rejected patch. Runs as background AUDIT task.
cards.when_not_to_use: Not for real-time repair — use incident_replay for that.

cards.tool_name: Master Cognitive Orchestrator — Central Control Plane
cards.description: The central metacognitive brain that routes to correct multi-tool pipeline chains based on CognitiveIntent. Dynamically merges tools: REPAIR=incident_replay+discovery+quarantine+synthesizer+governance, SYNTHESIS=dna+squeezer+truth+distiller+memory, AUDIT=gap_finder+drift+revaluation, EVOLUTION=proposal+governance+benchmark+canary.
cards.when_to_use: This is the primary entry point for all autonomous cognitive tasks. Prefer this over calling individual tools directly.
cards.when_not_to_use: For ultra-simple one-off CLI scripts that need no chaining.
outputs: PipelineExecutionResult: status, stages_completed, artifacts, confidence, evidence_ids
cards.cli_example:
python tools/master_orchestrator.py --intent repair --error 'TimeoutError'
python tools/master_orchestrator.py --intent synthesis --demand 'Build rate limiter'
python tools/master_orchestrator.py --intent audit

cards.description: Long-running background watchdog that monitors logs/health endpoints and triggers the self-healing pipeline whenever degradation is detected. Intended as a sidecar process.
cards.when_to_use: Deploy as background daemon alongside the SupremeAI backend in production.
cards.when_not_to_use: Not for one-shot repairs — use master_orchestrator --intent repair directly.
outputs: Continuous monitoring with triggered repair pipelines

cards.description: Validates readiness before any production deployment: checks test coverage, security scans, environment variable completeness, and governance policy clearance.
cards.when_to_use: Always as final gate in CI/CD before any git push to production or Render deploy.
cards.when_not_to_use: Not a development-time tool.

cards.tool_name: Script Execution Lifecycle Guide — When to Run Which Script
cards.description:
Complete decision guide for WHEN to run each SupremeAI script across all phases.

DEVELOPMENT PHASE (local coding):
  gap_finder.py → Run BEFORE committing. Catches dead code, missing tests, secrets.
  gap_miner/project_fingerprint.py → Run FIRST when starting a new feature synthesis.
  tool_knowledge_injector.py (dry-run) → Run after adding new tools to preview cards.

CI/CD PIPELINE (GitHub Actions):
  gap_finder.py → Runs on every PR push. Blocks merge if CRITICAL findings exist.
  autonomy/deploy_guard.py → Final CI gate before Render deploy. Mandatory.
  gap_miner/drift_detector.py → Weekly cron. Detects stale docs/schema mismatches.
  gap_miner/incident_replay.py → Runs immediately when CI fails.

AFTER INCIDENT / RUNTIME ERROR (REPAIR pipeline order):
  STEP 1: gap_miner/incident_replay.py → Parse error → get fingerprint.
  STEP 2: discovery_fabric/source_scout.py → Find open-source solutions.
  STEP 3: solution_synthesizer.py (dry-run) → Generate patch, no --apply yet.
  STEP 4: governance_policy validation → Validate patch target is allowlisted.
  STEP 5: solution_synthesizer.py --apply → Apply ONLY after all validation passes.

KNOWLEDGE & MEMORY OPERATIONS:
  tool_knowledge_injector.py --inject → When new Crown Jewel tools are added.
  knowledge_squeezer engine → For deep architectural decisions ONLY (not bug fixes).
  tool_knowledge_injector.py --verify → After injection to verify recall works.

EVOLUTION / SELF-IMPROVEMENT CYCLE:
  STEP 1: gap_finder.py → Baseline audit before evolution.
  STEP 2: knowledge_squeezer → Deep synthesis of improvement ideas.
  STEP 3: solution_synthesizer --apply → Apply approved changes.
  STEP 4: autonomy/deploy_guard.py → Final gate before deploy.
  STEP 5: tool_knowledge_injector.py --inject → Re-inject updated knowledge.
cards.when_to_use: Query this card whenever you need to decide WHICH script to run and IN WHAT ORDER for: development, CI failure, incident, or evolution cycle.
cards.when_not_to_use: Do not use to get implementation details of each tool — query individual tool cards for that.
inputs: situation: str (development | ci_failure | incident | evolution | knowledge_update)
outputs: Ordered script execution sequence with trigger conditions and safety gates
cards.cli_example:
# DEVELOPMENT: Before committing
python tools/gap_finder.py . --output reports/gap-report.json

# CI FAILURE: Immediate incident analysis
python tools/gap_miner/incident_replay.py --log logs/ci_error.txt

# AFTER INCIDENT: Find open-source solution
python tools/discovery_fabric/supremeai_discovery/source_scout.py "asyncio timeout fix"

# KNOWLEDGE UPDATE: After adding new tools
python tools/tool_knowledge_injector.py --inject --verify

# PRE-DEPLOY GATE: Always last
python tools/autonomy/deploy_guard.py . --env-check

cards.tool_name: Pipeline Split & Merge Strategy — When to Split, When to Merge
intent_triggers: kon stage e merge korte hobe
cards.description:
Complete decision guide for WHEN to SPLIT and WHEN to MERGE pipeline stages.

SPLIT (Fork / Parallel Execution) — কখন Split করবে:
  1. INDEPENDENT PARALLEL DISCOVERY:
     source_scout fans out to GitHub+PyPI+npm+HuggingFace simultaneously.
     Split AFTER incident_replay outputs fingerprint → 4 parallel searches.
  2. MULTI-MODEL ADVERSARIAL SYNTHESIS (knowledge_squeezer Stage 1):
     DeepSeek + Claude + Gemini generate INDEPENDENTLY (no anchoring bias).
     Split: Each model gets same topic → generates without seeing others.
  3. MULTI-FILE INDEPENDENT PATCHES:
     solution_synthesizer splits when ≥2 INDEPENDENT issues in gap-report.
     Split condition: Issues affect different files with zero shared imports.
  4. AUDIT PARALLELISM:
     gap_finder splits into: test_coverage + security + quality + dead_code.
     All 4 run in parallel threads → merged into unified gap-report.json.

MERGE (Convergence / Reduce) — কখন Merge করবে:
  1. TRUST SCORING REDUCES CANDIDATES:
     After source_scout parallel branches → MERGE into trust_engine.
     Condition: All parallel searches done AND ≥1 result returned.
  2. ADVERSARIAL AUDIT CONVERGENCE (knowledge_squeezer Stage 2):
     After Stage 1 independent generation → MERGE all model outputs.
     Condition: All providers responded OR timed out with fallback.
  3. QUARANTINE GATE:
     After trust_engine → MERGE into quarantine (trust_score ≥ 0.70 required).
  4. SOLUTION PATCH MERGE:
     After split branches generate patches → MERGE into unified diff.
     Condition: ALL patches pass sandbox + governance. If ANY fails → BLOCK all.
  5. FINAL SYNTHESIS MERGE (knowledge_squeezer Stage 5):
     After Stages 1-4 → MERGE into final synthesis.
     Condition: ≥2 models agree on core principles (consensus ≥60%).
     If consensus <60% → DO NOT MERGE → escalate to human review.

TOPOLOGY BY PIPELINE TYPE:
  REPAIR: incident_replay → [SPLIT×4 source_scout] → [MERGE: trust] → quarantine → synthesizer → governance → apply
  SYNTHESIS: fingerprint → [SPLIT×N models] → [MERGE: adversarial] → [SPLIT: socratic] → [MERGE: reconstruct] → truth → distill → memory
  AUDIT: [SPLIT×4 gap scanners] → [MERGE: gap-report.json] → drift_detector
  EVOLUTION: proposal → governance → [SPLIT×3 benchmarks] → [MERGE: score] → canary → integrity → promote
cards.when_to_use: Query when designing multi-stage pipelines to decide WHERE to insert parallel fan-out (SPLIT) and WHERE to insert convergence (MERGE) points.
cards.when_not_to_use: Not for single-tool invocations or simple sequential pipelines with no parallelism.
outputs: Split/Merge topology map with trigger conditions and failure rollback rules
cards.cli_example:
# Full split/merge pipeline via master orchestrator:
python tools/master_orchestrator.py --intent repair --error 'TimeoutError in ws_handler'
python tools/master_orchestrator.py --intent synthesis --demand 'Build zero-cost rate limiter'
python tools/master_orchestrator.py --intent audit

cards.tool_name: Tool Knowledge Injector — Self-Documentation & Re-Injection Policy
cards.description:
Re-injection policy for tool_knowledge_injector.py:

DRY-RUN (no flags) — always safe:
  When: Adding a new tool/module, previewing existing cards, verifying card content.
  Command: python tools/tool_knowledge_injector.py

LIVE INJECT (--inject):
  When: New tool passes governance + tests + CI green.
  When: Existing tool behavior significantly changed (new inputs/outputs/chain).
  When: After Phase milestone completion (Phase 2→3, 3→4 etc.).
  Command: python tools/tool_knowledge_injector.py --inject

INJECT + VERIFY (--inject --verify):
  When: First-time setup of ai_memory pgvector schema.
  When: After Supabase migration or vector store reset.
  When: Monthly scheduled re-injection to refresh embeddings.
  Command: python tools/tool_knowledge_injector.py --inject --verify

EXPORT (--export file.json):
  When: Debugging card content without touching DB.
  When: Pre-migration backup of knowledge registry.
  Command: python tools/tool_knowledge_injector.py --export reports/knowledge_cards.json

WARNING: Do NOT re-inject on every commit — duplicates create redundant pgvector rows.
Only inject when tool registry actually changes.
cards.when_to_use: Run after adding/modifying Crown Jewel tools, after phase milestones, or monthly. Always dry-run first to preview.
cards.when_not_to_use: Do not run if pgvector schema is not set up (Supabase ai_memory table must exist first).
cards.cli_example:
python tools/tool_knowledge_injector.py                     # dry-run preview
python tools/tool_knowledge_injector.py --inject             # live inject
python tools/tool_knowledge_injector.py --inject --verify    # inject + verify recall
python tools/tool_knowledge_injector.py --export reports/knowledge_cards_backup.json

cards.tool_name: Gap Finder Execution Schedule — When & How Often to Run
cards.description:
Gap Finder execution schedule and trigger conditions:

MANDATORY TRIGGERS (never skip):
  1. PRE-COMMIT (local): Before every git commit on feature branches.
     CRITICAL findings → fix before commit. Do NOT bypass with --no-verify.
  2. CI/CD PR CHECK: Runs on every pull_request GitHub Action automatically.
     Blocks merge if CRITICAL findings exist. Reports uploaded as CI artifacts.
  3. POST-MERGE (main branch): After every merge to main.
     Catches regressions. Triggers incident_replay automatically via CI.

SCHEDULED TRIGGERS:
  4. WEEKLY FULL AUDIT (Sunday midnight UTC): Full codebase scan.
     Output: reports/weekly-gap-{date}.json
  5. PRE-DEPLOY: Must complete with zero CRITICAL before deploy_guard.py runs.
     deploy_guard checks gap-report.json freshness (<24h).

ON-DEMAND TRIGGERS:
  6. AFTER MAJOR REFACTOR: Any time >50 files changed in one session.
  7. AFTER DEPENDENCY UPGRADE: After pip/npm major version bumps.
  8. BEFORE PHASE MILESTONE: Before closing any Phase (2→3, 3→4 etc.)

SEVERITY GATES:
  CRITICAL → Blocks CI merge. Fix immediately.
  HIGH     → Blocks production deploy. Fix before next release.
  MEDIUM   → Warning only. Fix within sprint.
  LOW      → Informational. Add to backlog.
cards.when_to_use: Use to determine the correct gap_finder run frequency and trigger for any given situation.
cards.when_not_to_use: Do not run inside hot path of user-facing API requests — offline/background tool only.
cards.cli_example:
# Pre-commit scan:
python tools/gap_finder.py . --output reports/gap-report.json

# Only CRITICAL and HIGH:
python tools/gap_finder.py . --severity high --output reports/gap-high.json

# Weekly audit with date:
python tools/gap_finder.py . --output reports/weekly-gap-$(date +%Y%m%d).json

cards.tool_name: Pipeline Recipe Compiler — Dynamic Pipeline Assembly
cards.description:
Pipeline Recipe Compiler — assembles multi-tool execution pipelines dynamically.

WHEN TO USE:
  - master_orchestrator cannot find a pre-built recipe for a novel task.
  - Composing a CUSTOM pipeline from individual tool cards.
  - Task requires a HYBRID pipeline (e.g., repair + synthesis combined).
  - Testing a new pipeline topology before promoting to orchestrator.

WHEN NOT TO USE:
  - Standard REPAIR/SYNTHESIS/AUDIT intents → use master_orchestrator directly.
  - Single-tool invocations → invoke the tool directly.

COMPILATION PHASES:
  1. Intent Classification → REPAIR | SYNTHESIS | AUDIT | EVOLUTION | HYBRID
  2. Tool Card Query → Fetch relevant cards from ai_memory by intent
  3. Dependency Graph Build → DAG from chain_before/chain_after metadata
  4. Topology Optimization → Insert SPLIT points for parallel-capable stages
  5. Safety Injection → Add governance_policy before any mutation step
  6. Recipe Output → Ordered execution plan with fallback paths

MERGE TRIGGERS IN COMPILED RECIPES:
  - After ANY parallel fan-out group completes (all branches done or timeout)
  - Before ANY mutation step (patch apply, memory write, skill creation)
  - At confidence gates (trust_score ≥ threshold before proceeding)
  - At phase boundaries (discovery → synthesis → validation → apply)
cards.when_to_use: Use when you need a custom tool chain for a novel task not covered by standard orchestrator intents.
cards.when_not_to_use: Do not use for standard intents — master_orchestrator handles those more efficiently.
outputs: ExecutionRecipe: ordered stages with split/merge topology, fallback paths, safety gates
cards.cli_example:
# Compile custom hybrid pipeline:
python tools/pipeline_recipe_compiler.py --intent hybrid --demand 'Fix AND improve rate limiter'

# Preview compiled recipe (dry-run):
python tools/pipeline_recipe_compiler.py --intent repair --context '{"error": "TimeoutError"}' --dry-run

# Export recipe as JSON:
python tools/pipeline_recipe_compiler.py --intent audit --export reports/audit_recipe.json
